rationale: Added QA-owned deterministic session and keyed-operation tests, plus an HTTP check for distinct account contexts and rejection before the guard's authorized response. The Spring Boot 4 AutoConfigureMockMvc import correction is retained without changing existing assertions. Focused execution was blocked because the Maven wrapper cannot find powershell and Maven is unavailable. The new keyed-operation tests specify that a fabricated or revoked session context is rejected before key proof, as required by the review findings and story contract.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC1: Proof validates /v2/account and /v2/tokeninfo using the same transient key and uses the account GUID as identity.
acceptance_checks.expected: Only valid proof returns access; malformed or invalid proof fails closed; replacement keys retain their own grants.
acceptance_checks.verification: Existing offline account and token-info fixtures remain available; AccountAccessContractTest exercises proof via the fixture adapter. Live upstream behavior is not tested.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC2: Sessions are opaque, bounded, process-local, and have an absolute 15-minute lease or earlier credential expiry.
acceptance_checks.expected: Reads do not extend the lease; credential expiry caps the lease; capacity eviction, rotation, and logout behave as specified.
acceptance_checks.verification: AccountSessionsTest uses a controlled Clock to check expiry, earlier credential expiry, bounded capacity and oldest-proof eviction, session/context rotation, and logout.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC3: Proof, renewal, context, and logout HTTP contracts enforce origin/CSRF and cookie policy.
acceptance_checks.expected: Proof returns a non-secret context and host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; state-changing requests validate origin; responses use no-store.
acceptance_checks.verification: Existing AccountAccessContractTest checks cookie and cache headers, foreign and missing Origin rejection, renewal, and logout.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC4: Account work requires a live session and matching context; caller account IDs are assertions only.
acceptance_checks.expected: Missing sessions receive 401; context, account, and grant mismatches receive 403 before authorized account handling; A and B contexts remain distinct.
acceptance_checks.verification: AccountAccessContractTest checks missing session, account and grant assertions, cross-session rejection, and distinct authorized context response headers.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC5: Operation grants and transient keyed operations are validated before upstream admission.
acceptance_checks.expected: A matching live context and key may proceed; fabricated/revoked contexts, identity mismatches, and insufficient grants are rejected. Definitive invalid credentials revoke the session; transient failures do not.
acceptance_checks.verification: AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest exercises successful admission, grant rejection before proof, fabricated/revoked context rejection before proof, identity and credential-grant mismatch, and invalid versus transient failure revocation behavior.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC6: Keys remain transient and responses/errors do not expose credentials.
acceptance_checks.expected: Credential material is absent from public proof output and cookie; account responses use no-store.
acceptance_checks.verification: Existing AccountAccessContractTest checks that the fixture key and account GUID are absent from proof output and that proof responses use no-store.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC7: Cached authorization can continue during upstream outage, renewal cannot succeed during outage, and logout requires matching context.
acceptance_checks.expected: A live lease remains valid across transient proof failure; a mismatched context cannot revoke another session.
acceptance_checks.verification: AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest checks transient failure leaves the session live; AccountAccessContractTest checks mismatched-context logout leaves the session usable.

invariants: Only the verified account GUID establishes account identity.
A replacement key cannot inherit grants from a prior key.
A session never stores or substitutes for a GW2 API key.
Session expiry is absolute and is not extended by reads or polling.
Credential expiry caps session expiry when earlier than the lease.
Caller-supplied account identifiers cannot select authorization scope.
A request or keyed operation must match the exact live session context before work or upstream admission.
Authorization failures disclose no account existence, contents, freshness, or credentials.
The database is a disposable cache; no backup or old-row survival behavior is tested.
existing_tests_reviewed: src/test/java/web/AccountAccessContractTest.java — proof, cookie and origin policy, context matching, logout, account/grant assertions, and safe proof errors; retained and extended.
src/test/java/web/AccountSyncApiControllerTest.java — account synchronization HTTP behavior; no session or context coverage.
src/test/java/web/AccountLuckApiControllerTest.java — account-Luck endpoint behavior; no session or context coverage.
src/test/java/web/AccountDataFreshnessInterceptorTest.java — freshness boundary behavior; no account-session coverage.
src/test/java/web/Gw2ApiApplicationBootTest.java — application wiring and route mapping; no session proof coverage.
interface_contract: AccountSessions.establish(AccountProof proof), resolve(String sessionId, String assertedContext), revoke(String sessionId), and size()
application.access.AccountProof(String accountId, Set<AccountGrant> grants, Set<String> endpointRestrictions, Instant credentialExpiresAt)
AccountAccessService.authorizeKeyedOperation(String sessionId, AccountContext context, String apiKey, AccountOperation operation)
POST /api/session accepts the GW2 key only in X-GW2-API-Key and requires Origin validation.
POST /api/session/renew accepts the session cookie, X-Account-Context, and X-GW2-API-Key.
POST /api/session/logout requires the session cookie, X-Account-Context, and Origin validation.
Account requests use the GW2_SESSION cookie and X-Account-Context header.
Proof response JSON exposes a non-secret string field named accessContext.
GET /api/account/luck and GET /api/account/bank are protected account-operation examples.
Protected account requests may accept accountId only as a consistency assertion.
test_specifications: AccountSessionsTest advances a controlled clock to verify reads do not extend the 15-minute lease and that an earlier credential expiry terminates access.
AccountSessionsTest inserts beyond capacity and checks the oldest session is evicted while the store remains bounded.
AccountSessionsTest verifies fresh session and context identifiers across issuance, and that logout revokes only the selected session.
AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest verifies a matching session, context, key identity, and grants admit a keyed LUCK_READ.
AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest verifies insufficient session grants prevent proof-port invocation; fabricated context and revoked session are expected to fail before proof.
AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest verifies account mismatch and insufficient credential grants reject admission.
AccountAccessServiceKeyedOperationTest verifies definitive invalid credentials revoke the session, while a retryable ProofUnavailableException leaves it live.
AccountAccessContractTest verifies separate account sessions receive distinct authorized X-Account-Context values and that a B cookie paired with A context is rejected with 403 and no-store.
Existing HTTP contract checks remain for cookie/cache policy, origin validation, malformed proof, account/grant assertions, logout matching, and unauthenticated access.
